review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: What You'll Be Doing You'll provide day-to-day operational support, administration and maintenance for customer systems platforms across on-premise and datacentre environments. Your Responsibilities Will Include: Monitoring service health and using alerts, logs, metrics and trend data to identify degradation before it becomes a larger issue Investigating and resolving incidents across Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, virtualisation, storage, backup and related services
eligibility_evidence: We embrace diversity in all its forms, valuing individuals regardless of age, disability, gender identity or reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We use proven technology, specialist teams and domain expertise to build solid technical foundations across platforms, data and business applications. Your Responsibilities Will Include: Monitoring service health and using alerts, logs, metrics and trend data to identify degradation before it becomes a larger issue Investigating and resolving incidents across Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, virtualisation, storage, backup and related services Managing incidents, service requests, changes and operational tasks against agreed service commitments and customer priorities Supporting root-cause analysis and problem management, with a focus on permanent fixes rather than repeated workarounds Carrying out patching, configuration changes, vulnerability remediation, platform maintenance and operational housekeeping Supporting upgrades, migrations, hardware refreshes, dec
